name: Behavioral Economics Games Benchmark
description: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) in diverse applications requires a thorough understanding of their decision-making strategies and behavioral patterns. As a supplement to a recent study on the behavioral Turing test, this paper presents a comprehensive analysis of five leading LLM-based chatbot families as they navigate a series of behavioral economics games. By benchmarking these AI chatbots, we aim to uncover and document both common and distinct behavioral patterns across a range of scenarios. The findings provide valuable insights into the strategic preferences of each LLM, highlighting potential implications for their deployment in critical decision-making roles.
reputation: A niche, emerging benchmark with limited adoption, mainly used to study LLM behavior in behavioral economics settings.
notes: Non-standard benchmark with no widely established leaderboard; results are more diagnostic than saturating, and scoring may vary by game and payoff structure.
